privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_text: We collect only the information necessary to operate the service, such as phone number, name, and location of residence to ensure you reach nearby local offers.
privacy.s2_text: Your data is used to improve your experience in the application and facilitate communication between the buyer and the seller via internal chat.
privacy.s3_text: We use advanced encryption technologies to protect your data from unauthorized access. Your password and personal data are fully encrypted.
privacy.s4_text: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes without your explicit consent.
privacy.s5_text: You always have the right to modify your data or permanently delete your account from within the profile settings, and all your associated data will be deleted immediately.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1_text: By using the "Barmeh" application, you agree to be bound by these terms of use. If you do not agree to any part of them, please stop using the platform.
terms.s2_text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account information and activities. You must provide accurate and correct information when registering.
terms.s3_text: It is prohibited to post any illegal, fake advertisements, or containing materials that violate the local laws in force in the Syrian Arab Republic.
terms.s4_text: "Barmeh" is an intermediary platform to connect the buyer and the seller. We do not guarantee the quality of the products displayed or the credibility of the parties, and transactions are at the users' own risk.
terms.s5_text: "Barmeh" application currently offers its services for free, and we reserve the right to charge fees for certain services in the future after notifying users.
